# API route conventions

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from '@/lib/apiResponse';
return apiResponse.success(res, data);
return apiResponse.notFound(res, 'Resource', id);
return apiResponse.error(res, 'Message');
```

## Critical

- **Nested dynamic routes FAIL on Vercel** — flatten them. `contractors-stages.ts`, not `contractors/[id]/stages.ts`.
- Use specific param names (`[projectId]`, not `[id]`).
- No `console.log` — use `log` from `@/lib/logger`.
- No empty catch blocks.

## DB

- Prefer `pg.Pool` via `@/lib/db` or `@/lib/db-pool` for new code.
- `lib/db/pool.js` still imports `@neondatabase/serverless` (tech debt). If a route 500s, check for the Neon shim first.
- No conditional SQL fragments via the Neon shim — breaks shim callers.

## Two drop tables — DO NOT CONFUSE

- `drops` — SOW imports (`/api/sow/drops`)
- `qa_photo_reviews` — WhatsApp QA data (`/api/wa-monitor-*`)
